meta.title: AgentBridge — File Preview Sequence
meta.subtitle: End-to-End Sequence from Telegram Callback to Sandboxed Bounded Preview
meta.description: Sequence diagram tracing a file preview request through Telegram ChatOps, Control Plane, Local Runtime, File Access Layer, Sandbox Validation, Redaction, and bounded response transmission.

participants.label: Telegram User
participants.description: Mobile developer navigating codebase and requesting file preview.

participants.label:
TelegramBotApp
(sutra/apps/telegram)
participants.description: Validates callback query, decodes target context, and dispatches command.

participants.label: ControlPlane
participants.description: Authenticates operator session and routes command over WSS to connected device.

participants.label:
LocalRuntime
(sutra/runtime)
participants.description: Executes command, binds workspace scope, and coordinates file access.

participants.label:
Sandbox Security
(sutra/security)
participants.description: Enforces workspace boundaries, denies symlink escapes, blocks sensitive files.

participants.label:
FileAccessLayer
(sutra/file_access)
participants.description: Streams bounded slice (e.g. lines 1-35), detects binary, counts lines, extracts symbols.

participants.label:
RedactionEngine
(sutra/redaction)
participants.description: Redacts API keys, credentials, and tokens line-by-line before returning content.
